inlines.v: ECCOPROT'IC, adjective [Gr. out or from, and stercus.] Having the quality of promoting alvine discharges; laxative; loosening; gently cathartic. ECCOPROT'IC, noun A medicine which purges gently, or which tends to promote evacuations by stool; a mild cathartic.
